Provenance of each string is in `_provenance` below.
headline: Remember every character.
mechanism: Flashcards with image hints, audio, and instant recall scoring — so the words you nearly know stop slipping.

_provenance.badge: HSK levels present in terraform/csv (HSK2-HSK6.csv + wordsets.csv); 'Free' — no paywall exists in the app.
_provenance.headline: New line. Closest existing phrasing is the logo tagline 'Master Chinese Vocabulary'; 'Remember every character' names the outcome rather than the activity, which is the shape FL's 'Read Your Ancestors' Handwriting' uses.
_provenance.mechanism: Composed from index.html's meta description ('interactive flashcards', 'AI-powered learning tools') plus the features visible in the app itself (image hints, audio on the answer card, recall scoring).

_open_question_for_review: The headline is the one string not traceable to existing copy. 'Remember every character.' is a claim about outcome; 'Master Chinese vocabulary' (the current tagline) is safer but weaker in a feed. Lead/Alex call — the generator does not depend on which is chosen.
